macro.title: Delta rolls out new basic business, premium economy tickets - The Points Guy
macro.summary: Delta Air Lines is launching basic versions of its premium tickets with new restrictions for customers who spring for the discount.

macro.title: United must face lawsuit over 'window seats' that don't have windows, judge rules - Fox Business
macro.summary: A federal judge ruled passengers plausibly alleged United Airlines breached its agreement by selling certain window seats without an actual window, allowing the proposed class action to proceed.

macro.title: Used EVs keep getting more expensive amid Iran war, high gas prices - CNBC
macro.summary: The Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index for EVs — which tracks prices of used vehicles sold at its U.S. wholesale auctions — increased 12% compared to June 2025.
